reason: Intermex sells cross-border remittances to immigrants through agent, store and digital channels and earns per-transfer fees and FX spread. Dave sells interest-free cash advances and a checking account to US paycheck-to-paycheck consumers through its app. It earns from optional fees, tips and interchange. Both are consumer fintechs, but the products, the customer need and the revenue mechanics differ.
